actors.name: uk-company-search
actors.title: UK Company Register Search
actors.description: Search the UK company register by the start of a name, company number, status, country or industry code. Register facts only, no contacts.

q.title: Company name starts with
q.description: Matched from the start of the registered name.

events.name: search-with-results
events.title: Search with results
events.description: One search that returns at least one company, up to 100 rows.

returns: Company name, number, status, type and incorporation date
Jurisdiction, registered address town and country, industry codes
Whether the register holds persons of significant control for the company
actors.limits: Covers the UK register only. The data is held from the register and can lag behind it; check the official register before relying on a record. At least one filter is needed.

actors.name: work-email-finder
actors.title: Work Email Finder
actors.description: Find the most likely work email for a named person at a company domain, with a verification status. Charged only when an address is found.

website.title: Company website
website.description: The company's domain, for example example.com.

name.title: Person's name
name.description: First and last name of the person.

events.name: email-found
events.title: Email found
events.description: One email address returned for your input.

returns: The email address
A verification status: verified, risky or invalid
When it was checked
actors.limits: A status is not a delivery guarantee. Use the addresses only where the law allows you to contact that person, and honour opt-outs. The address in the sample is masked.

actors.name: us-federal-contractor-check
actors.title: US Federal Contractor Check
actors.description: Check one US federal contractor against the official public records: registration, totals, largest contracts and, in full mode, tables by year and agency.

company.title: Contractor
company.description: A company name, a 12-character UEI or a 5-character CAGE code.

mode.title: Depth
mode.description: Snapshot: registration, five-year totals, top five contracts, one verdict. Full: adds tables by year and agency, active contracts, modifications and subcontracts.

returns: Registration details and how the contractor was matched
Five-year totals and the largest contracts, with record links
A plain verdict, and what was not checked
actors.limits: US federal records only, as of the date shown in the result. It is not legal advice and not a complete responsibility check: confirm exclusions on the official site before an award decision.

actors.name: us-nonprofit-check
actors.title: US Nonprofit Check
actors.description: Check one US tax-exempt organization using the IRS files: exemption status, revocation list and headline figures, with more detail in full mode.

ein.title: EIN
ein.description: Fill in either the EIN or the name.

name.title: Organization name
name.description: Fill in either the name or the EIN. A name that matches several organizations returns the candidates, free.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter state, to narrow a name search.

mode.title: Depth
mode.description: Snapshot: status, latest headline figures, one verdict. Full: adds filings, ratios, people and grants where the returns carry them.

returns: Exemption status and whether the organization is on the revocation list
Latest headline figures from its returns
A plain verdict, and what the files do not cover
actors.limits: US organizations in the IRS files only. Returns are filed late by nature, so figures can be more than a year old.

actors.name: company-due-diligence-report
actors.title: Company Due Diligence Report
actors.description: A sourced due diligence report on one company, written for the decision you pick, such as buying from them, joining them or lending to them. Takes several minutes.

name.title: Company name
name.description: Fill in the name, the domain or both.

angle.title: Decision
enumTitles: Hiring the team by buying it
angle.description: The decision the report is written for.

country.title: Country
country.description: Where the company is, if the name is common.

events.name: company-report
events.title: Company report
events.description: One finished report. Set the run timeout to at least 30 minutes.

returns: The report as a web page, as Markdown and as structured sections
Links to the sources behind its statements
No charge when the company cannot be found
actors.limits: A research aid built from public information, which can be incomplete or out of date. It is not legal, credit or investment advice: open the sources before you decide.

actors.name: show-hn-best-time
actors.title: Show HN Best Time to Post
actors.description: How often Show HN posts reached 50 and 100 points: overall, for the best hour and day, and for the slot you ask about. Counts, not a prediction.
returns: The share of posts reaching 50 and 100 points, overall
The best hour and day
The same shares for your weekday and hour, with the number of posts behind them
actors.limits: Past shares are not a forecast for your post. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Hacker News.

actors.name: product-changelog-lookup
actors.title: Product Changelog Lookup
actors.description: The newest changelog entries held for a software product, each with date, title, a short summary and the vendor's own link.

limit.title: Entries
limit.description: How many of the newest entries.

events.name: changelog-lookup
events.title: Changelog lookup
events.description: One lookup of a tracked product that returns entries.

returns: Date and title of each entry
A short summary of each
The vendor's own link for each entry
actors.limits: Only tracked products have entries; an untracked product costs nothing. Entries can lag behind the vendor's page. Not affiliated with the vendors listed.
